data.one_liner: A simple flutter input widget to add @ mentions functionality to your app.
data.what_it_does: Provides a text input widget that detects trigger characters like '@' or '#' and displays a suggestion overlay list for mentions. Generates markup text from selected mentions.
use_when: You need to add user tagging or hashtag functionality inside a text field
You want custom suggestion lists tied to specific trigger characters
avoid_when: You do not need any form of mentions or trigger-based autocompletion
You are not willing to wrap your application in a Portal widget
strengths: Supports multiple mention triggers with custom data and styling
Allows custom suggestion builders and markup generation
Includes features like search change callbacks and default text population
weaknesses: Requires wrapping the top-level widget with a Portal widget
Limited documentation on advanced edge cases beyond basic usage
data.setup_notes: Must wrap the top-most widget (e.g., above MaterialApp) with a Portal widget from flutter_portal.
